text:
sanjay: Heads-up — we're hitting GPU quota limits in us-west1 for p100/a100 (40GB) and some pods are Pending. Need to discuss a new node pool design and scaling policy.

maria: ugh, saw that in the cluster dashboard. Which workloads are blocked?

sanjay: mostly the batch inference jobs for rerank + a couple of large streaming endpoints that request 32GB GPUs.

anna: Are those pods using specific nodeSelector/taints? We currently have a single `gpu-pool` with taint `nvidia.com/gpu=true:NoSchedule`.

sanjay: yes, nodeSelector: `pool=gpu-pool`. The problem is the instance type mix — we only had A100-40 in that pool and quotas are exhausted.

ben: Options: 1) create a burst pool with A10G (cheaper, 24GB) for lower-SLO jobs, 2) create a mixed-instance pool (A100 + A10) with labels for model class, or 3) request quota increase.

maria: +1 to mixed pools. For safety we should taint the burst pool with `gpu=burst:NoSchedule` so only tolerating pods land there. Cheap models can tolerate it.

infra-bot: Auto-note: last quota increase request (ticket #6292) was denied due to region capacity constraints.

anna: We also need to tune cluster-autoscaler flags. Current flags: `--scale-down-delay=10m` and `--max-node-provision-time=15m`. For GPU cold starts, we might need `--max-node-provision-time=20m` to avoid thrashing.

sanjay: Agree. Also consider `--expander=least-waste` so CA prefers nodes that minimize leftover GPU memory.

ben: For new nodepool naming I'd propose: `gpu-burst-usw1-a10g-v1` and `gpu-prod-usw1-a100-v1`. Keep prod pinned to reserved capacity. Burst can be preemptible/spot.

maria: Spot A10G is a good cost saver but need automatic fallback to prod pool on eviction. We can set pod priorityClass for real-time endpoints to high and node affinity to prod.

cloud-ops: FYI cloud quotas: A100 quota per project in us-west1 currently 8 GPUs. A10G quota has room but regional capacity may fluctuate. We can open a quota ticket now but likely multi-week approval.

anna: Action items: 1) create burst A10G node pool (preemptible), tainted `gpu=burst:NoSchedule`, label `gpu-type=a10g`. 2) update deployment tolerations and nodeAffinity for lower-SLO workloads. 3) tweak CA flags and `scale-down-unneeded-time` to 15m. 4) open support ticket for A100 quota bump.

sanjay: I'll spin up a prototype pool in staging first. Example gcloud for node pool (staging):

```
# create mixed machine pool (example)
gcloud container node-pools create gpu-burst-usw1-a10g-v1 \
  --cluster=redwood-usw1-cluster \
  --zone=us-west1-b \
  --machine-type=a2-highgpu-1g \
  --accelerator=type=nvidia-a10g,count=1 \
  --num-nodes=1 \
  --preemptible \
  --node-labels=gpu-type=a10g,pool=burst \
  --node-taints=gpu=burst:NoSchedule
```

maria: Also add kubelet arg to enable GPU driver install from DaemonSet if not already present. Use our driver-installer DS with tolerations for the taint.

ben: We should add HPA and KEDA checks; for large-model pods that reserve a whole GPU, autoscaler should treat them as unsplittable. Make sure `--balance-similar-node-groups` is on.

anna: PDBs: set `maxUnavailable: 1` for critical endpoints during rolling updates, and ensure `PodDisruptionBudget` doesn't block scale-down in burst pool.

cloud-ops: Cost estimate: A10G preemptible ~ $0.80-1.10/hr depending on region, A100-40GB on-demand ~ $8-9/hr. So shifting non-critical workloads saves a lot.

sanjay: Reminder — add monitoring labels and cost-center tags so Console shows token-level cost per pool. Also register new pool with node-exporter and GPU metrics for autoscaling signals.

maria: I'll prepare the manifests for tolerations/affinity and update helm charts. sanjay can you create the staging pool and smoke test?

sanjay: On it. I'll post results here once I roll out staging. If quota request times out we'll route larger models to an on-demand dedicated Dedicated cluster in us-central for now.

ben: One more thought — for model variants that use less memory, we can set `device-plugin` to advertise fractional GPU (MPS) — but that needs kernel + driver support. Might be worth an eval after pool is up.

anna: Cool. tagging @cloud-ops for quota ticket follow-up.

infra-bot: Action logged: created task INFRA-2108: "Provision gpu-burst-usw1-a10g-v1 in staging" assigned to sanjay.
